claim: the product not carried: no dataset, no workset, nothing that remains
quote: THE PRODUCT NOT CARRIED. The census row reads the center as a receiving apparatus with its product on record: derived datasets 'computed from the volumes', listed on the home page as 'Extracted Features BookNLP dataset Word frequencies Geographic locations', and 'Some HTRC resources remain available and can be used without an HTRC Analytics account'.
